scope: Every future Hotspawn CS2 Pick'ems card read at 2026-10-24T05:31Z (25) reconciled with the pick rows the published site serves (19), plus the line evidence available for the 9 uncovered cards.
method: Each row was read first-hand through the agent's page fetcher (the sandbox shell has no route to these hosts) and copied verbatim with a read timestamp into data/research/73bc57bd/observations-2026-10-24.json; scripts/73bc57bd_reconcile.py joins that record with the deployed branch-root pick rows and tests/test_73bc57bd_reconciliation.py re-derives the arithmetic. No probability, pick or alias was written by hand.

items.finding: 9 of the 25 future cards on the live Hotspawn lobby have no row, and therefore no pick, on the published site (all CCT Europe 2026 Series #11/#12). The scheduled publisher has failed four consecutive runs at the 'Regression tests' step, so nothing has been collected and published since 2026-10-23T19:57:15Z and the site still serves the 2026-10-23T20:10:00Z snapshot.
items.handling: Recorded here and in the dated dossier with the run ids. The regression that blocked every refresh is fixed in this PR (see 73bc57bd-duplicate-no-line-research-id) after the wall-clock errors were cleared by PR #240; the next scheduled run therefore collects and publishes, and the nine cards enter the normal ladder — five already show a real two-sided external price, four show only placeholder books that the existing policy correctly refuses.

evidence.detail: Latest failure: job verify-and-deploy, failing step 'Regression tests (repository fixtures, before any cache restore)'; no collection or deploy step ran.

items.finding: Reproduced first-hand: .venv/bin/python -m unittest tests.test_ca7e10e5_snapshot fails with 3 ERRORs (PublishRefused: 'snapshot 2026-10-23T09:23:57+00:00 is 20.2h old (limit 12.0h)') and 1 FAILURE (two id="no-line-research" blocks on the built executive summary). This is the step that stops every scheduled refresh.
items.handling: Reproduced and quoted verbatim in the dossier; the file is claimed by three other live sessions (arena-43110640, arena-be019782, arena-f1277d3b) at the time of writing, so it was not edited here. The production freshness guard itself is behaving correctly — the test fixture, not the guard, is time-bombed.

evidence.detail: Pins the fixture snapshot to 2026-10-23T09:23:57Z and calls root_publish.build_plan without an injectable clock.
build_plan refuses a snapshot older than 12h against the wall clock unless --allow-stale is passed.
Same test file fails the scheduled run before collection.

items.finding: The built executive summary carries id="no-line-research" twice (the summary and its compact unresolved register both render the dated block), which is an invalid duplicate landmark target and is asserted against by the existing test.
items.handling: Fixed in this PR after a documented takeover. The defect was claimed by arena-be019782 (PR #237, still open) but main stayed red: run 40063011446 and the next three scheduled runs failed on this assertion, and PR #240 (merged 2026-10-24T06:10Z) only cleared the wall-clock errors. Because a red main means no refresh can publish, the minimal non-destructive change was applied: the compact register no longer emits the block a second time, so summary() renders it exactly once and /unresolved/ keeps its own copy. Nothing else in scripts/build.py changed and none of the owning session's work was reverted; their PR keeps its fuller change set. Verified: site/index.html and site/unresolved/index.html each contain exactly one id="no-line-research"; tests.test_ca7e10e5_snapshot, tests.test_eea4c104_audit, tests.test_42bfa8ea and tests.test_3016b0c6_mobile_glance all pass (76 targeted tests green).

evidence.detail: summary() and unresolved_register(..., compact=True) both emit the dated research block.
assertEqual(html.count('id="no-line-research"'), 1) fails with 2 != 1 on the local build.
